text:
olivia (PM): Kicking off this thread — we need a compact onboarding rubric + recruitment script for the seed customer pilot next quarter. Target: 6 active seats (2 enterprise high-touch, 4 self-serve). Who can draft pieces?

sam (Eng): I can own the tech checklist (dedicated vs hosted differences) and the CI smoke eval. Need acceptance test list.

maya (Design): I’ll take the product walkthrough and quick task flows. Propose: 10-min walkthrough + 3 short tasks that validate core flows.

lee (Research): Add a minimal eval plan: golden prompts, regression triggers, and prompt set to run daily. Also include privacy/PII checklist for Private customers.

jordan (CS): I’ll draft customer comms and expected SLAs. Suggest two onboarding tracks: "Enable" (hand-holding) and "Starter" (self-serve).

olivia (PM): Success criteria to bake in the rubric: 1) 95% completion of onboarding tasks within 14 days, 2) <2 regression alerts/week on golden prompts, 3) Day-30 NPS >= 30.

sam (Eng): For rollout safety we need rollback triggers. Example: if p95 latency > 2x baseline on >10% calls for 15m => auto-fallback to smaller model. Also require a smoke harness.

sam (Eng): Example CI command for smoke eval (put in infra):

```
# quick seed onboarding smoke run
python infra/evals/run_eval.py --suite seed_onboarding_smoke --short
```

maya (Design): Feedback loop plan: daily 15m check for week 0, weekly for first month, then biweekly. Shared Miro + a short feedback form (3 questions). I'll make the template.

lee (Research): Instrumentation events to capture: onboarding.started, walkthrough.completed, task1.success, task2.success, regression.alert. Hook those into Console and Optimize dashboards.

ops-bot: Reminder — draft privacy addendum template is at https://redwood.internal/legal/seed-addendum (internal).

jordan (CS): :thumbsup: I’ll create week 0/2/4 check-in scripts and a support playbook (SLA expectations, escalation path). Need candidate sourcing criteria to finalize invites.

olivia (PM): Sourcing guidance: prioritize existing heavy-hosted customers + two enterprise prospects willing to be higher-touch. Prefer teams with low-latency interactive UIs. Post shortlist here by EOD.

sam (Eng): Also we should define telemetry thresholds for success: tokens/sec per seat, median latency targets, error rate < 0.5%.

maya (Design): I’ll prototype the onboarding email and in-product tooltip copy, then share A/B variants.

olivia (PM): Action items — sam: tech checklist + CI eval (due in 48h); maya: feedback flow + templates (48h); lee: instrumentation spec and eval suite (72h); jordan: comms + sourcing list (EOD). I’ll stitch into a 1-page playbook after these land.

jordan (CS): Also capture activation metric: tokens/week per active seat (wk1 vs wk4) and pilot-support-ticket tag = pilot-onboarding.

sam (Eng): ACK.

maya (Design): :sparkles: Looking to post first templates in the thread in the morning.

olivia (PM): Great — thanks all. If anyone runs into blockers with legal or infra quotas ping me directly.
